scenes.title: Two Neighbors
scenes.body: A small bear lived on one side of the hill. A fluffy rabbit lived on the other. They waved every morning, but they had never said hello.
scenes.altText: Scene 1 of a story about friendship.

scenes.title: A Shiny Surprise
scenes.body: One day, the bear found a shiny blue pebble. The rabbit found a smooth pink one. They both ran to the middle of the hill to show each other.
scenes.altText: Scene 2 of a story about friendship.

scenes.title: The Lost Pebble
scenes.body: While playing tag, the rabbit dropped the pink pebble into a patch of tall grass. The little bear helped search and search. At last, the bear found it under a big leaf.
scenes.altText: Scene 3 of a story about friendship.

scenes.title: Friends Forever
scenes.body: The rabbit thanked the bear with a big hug. They put their pebbles together in a little mossy nest. 'The best treasure,' said the bear, 'is a friend like you.'
scenes.altText: Scene 4 of a story about friendship.
